title: Cricketer Abhishek Sharma moves Delhi High Court for protection of personality rights
description: Indian cricketer Abhishek Sharma has filed a suit before the Delhi High Court seeking protection of his personality rights and takedown of alleged defamatory and Artificial Intelligence-generated (AI) content portraying him in bad light.
